name: whisper-tiny-polish
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-tiny (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of openai/whisper-tiny, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.038 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence None, repo created 2025-01-19. CAVEAT: single WER row, test set is FBK-MT/Speech-MASSIVE-test in the same language/domain as fine-tuning, and the card warns that case and punctuation in the references inflate WER for both models.

benchmarks.name: WER, Polish voice commands (FBK-MT/Speech-MASSIVE test)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Base model | Fine-tuned model |' row '| 0.8435 | 0.3176 |' under 'Word Error Rate on the test set': base openai/whisper-tiny 84.35 vs this model 31.76. Dataset FBK-MT/Speech-MASSIVE-test, Polish utterances. Card notes no normalization of case/punctuation in the ground truth.
